description: Header file defining the class 'data_flow_uplane_downlink_metrics_decorator' which decorates data flow metrics collection for downlink data in a fronthaul user-plane context, including resource usage measurement and latency metrics.

classes.name: data_flow_uplane_downlink_metrics_decorator
classes.description: A decorator class for collecting metrics on downlink data flow, including latency and CPU usage, with thread-safe counters.

methods.name: get_operation_controller
methods.description: Returns a reference to the operation controller managing the data flow.

methods.name: enqueue_section_type_1_message
methods.description: Enqueues a section type 1 message, measuring resource usage and updating latency metrics.

methods.name: get_metrics_collector
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the metrics collector interface.

methods.name: collect_metrics
methods.description: Aggregates and resets latency and CPU usage metrics for reporting.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal counters and latency measurements.
